This document lists what the client provides before Spark Technologies deploys the AI Calling Agent. It
applies to any organisation. No company specific detail is assumed.
The list covers the server, the telephone system, the network, the access needed to install the system, and
the business information used to configure the agent.
Spark Technologies installs the system on the client's server, connects it to the client's telephone
system, configures the agent, and tests live calls. Work starts once the items in this document
The client provides one dedicated server for the AI Calling Agent. The server is for this system.
Linux is required. Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, 64 bit, is the version Spark Technologies installs on.
The server must be able to run continuously. It needs stable power, a stable network connection, and
remote access so Spark Technologies can deploy the system and maintain it.
The telephone system already in place must be able to work with the agent.
The PBX or SBC must provide:
Calls in both directions between the telephone system and the agent
